mapper.update: UPDATE zh_guarantee_info a,(SELECT a.* FROM clms_ed_credit_info a,(SELECT customerid,MAX( creditno ) AS creditno FROM clms_ed_credit_info b WHERE substring( hive_sys_time, 1, 10 )= #{ydate} AND REPLACE(expiredate,'/','-')> #{ydate} AND credittype = 010010 AND customername LIKE '%担保%' GROUP BY customerid ) b WHERE a.customerid = b.customerid AND a.creditno = b.creditno AND substring( a.hive_sys_time, 1, 10 )= #{ydate} AND REPLACE( a.expiredate,'/','-')> #{ydate} AND a.credittype = 010010 AND a.customername LIKE '%担保%' ) b SET a.client_num=b.customerid,a.client_name=b.customername ,a.notional_amount=b.execnominalsum,a.occupy_notional_amount=b.usablenominalsum , a.occupy_exposure_amount=b.usablenominalsum , a.usablenominalsum=b.suboccupynominalsum , a.`start`=b.startdate , a.last_expire=b.expiredate , a.operator=b.inputuserid ,a.create_time=SYSDATE() WHERE a.client_name=b.customername
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zh_guarantee_info ( client_num, client_name, notional_amount, occupy_notional_amount, occupy_exposure_amount, usablenominalsum, `start`, last_expire, operator ) SELECT a.customerid,a.customername,a.execnominalsum,a.usablenominalsum,a.usablenominalsum, a.suboccupynominalsum,a.startdate,a.expiredate,a.inputuserid FROM clms_ed_credit_info a,( SELECT customerid,MAX( creditno ) AS creditno FROM clms_ed_credit_info b WHERE substring( hive_sys_time, 1, 10 )= #{ydate} AND REPLACE(b.expiredate,'/','-')> #{ydate} AND credittype = 010010 AND customername LIKE '%担保%' GROUP BY customerid ) b WHERE a.customerid = b.customerid AND a.creditno = b.creditno AND substring( a.hive_sys_time, 1, 10 )= #{ydate} AND REPLACE( a.expiredate, '/','-')> #{ydate} AND a.credittype = 010010 AND a.customername LIKE '%担保%' AND customername NOT IN ( SELECT client_name FROM zh_guarantee_info )

insert into ccms_business_contract (customerid,customername, exposurebalance,usableexposuresum, usablenominalsum,businesssum2,putoutdate,maturity,operateuserid) select customerid,customername, suboccupynominalsum , usablenominalsum ,usablenominalsum , execnominalsum ,startdate,expiredate,inputuserid from clms_ed_credit_info where substring( hive_sys_time ,1,10)= #{ydate} and credittype =000020
